title: GuardEval: A Multi-Perspective Benchmark for Evaluating Safety, Fairness, and Robustness in LLM Moderators

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM moderation models' ability to classify prompts and responses containing explicit and implicit racial abuse, identity-based attacks, and slurs using aggregated datasets like HateBase, MetaHate, and HateCheck.

Assessing moderation models on their detection of sexism, stereotypes, and gender-based representational harms by classifying conversational interactions as safe or unsafe within the unified GuardEval benchmark.

Testing moderation guardrails against a comprehensive sociotechnical harm taxonomy that includes representational harms, toxicity, and exclusion targeting various marginalized groups using diverse human-AI interaction datasets.
